+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.api import create_app, get_conn
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def app(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "health.db"
+    ledger.open_db(path).close()
+    return create_app(path, seed_if_empty=False)
+
+
+def test_health_is_ok_without_a_login(app):
+    response = TestClient(app).get("/api/health")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"status": "ok", "database": "ok"}
+
+
+def test_health_is_503_when_the_database_cannot_be_read(app, tmp_path):
+    def closed_conn():
+        conn = ledger.open_db(tmp_path / "closed.db")
+        conn.close()
+        yield conn
+
+    app.dependency_overrides[get_conn] = closed_conn
+    response = TestClient(app).get("/api/health")
+    assert response.status_code == 503
+    assert response.json().get("database") == "error"
